name: zog-presence-aware-merge-parsing
instr:
zog cannot merge partial input into an existing destination without erasing omitted state. Add presence-aware merging that preserves established parsing behavior and deterministically reports changed, retained, and rejected locations. Failed work must expose no tentative mutations or report entries.

Struct, slice, pointer, union, string, numeric, boolean, and other primitive schemas must distinguish supplied locations from omissions and commit only successful candidates. Supplied zero values remain supplied. Omitted slice positions and tails remain intact. Omitted pointers retain identity; explicit nil remains distinct.

Only the first successful branch contributes mutations and locations. If all fail, preserve the destination and return established branch issues. Report stable root-to-leaf segments in deterministic schema and input traversal order.

Supplied primitives retain existing coercion, required, default, catch, and processor behavior. Omitted locations invoke none. Processor rejection revokes the candidate outcome. Options compose with existing execution options, including issue formatting, without changing later Parse or Validate behavior on a reusable schema.

Preserve issue formatting, ordering, path and value snapshots, and collection safety. Incompatible destinations produce issues without committed locations. ZSS must expose omission-preserving merge capability consistently for primitive, container, pointer, struct, and union shapes, without recording runtime
